text_block_list.text:
After the Fan Appreciation Festival ended 
and we finished our usual training, Gold 
City called me over, saying she wanted to 
talk.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You know... I figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I 'became' empty. There was 
nothing there from the very beginning... 
nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Entering the Hanshin JF was to meet 
expectations. Choosing the Classic Triple 
Crown was because I hated just doing what 
my manager told me to.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You know what that is? Just childish 
rebellion. I was merely being a 
contrarian.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was choosing my own races, but 
that wasn't the case at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Becoming a model and acting the way they 
wanted. Choosing to run and acting the way 
they didn't want.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I thought the two were different things. 
But really, they're both the same—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Without someone else's voice to guide me, 
I wouldn't have been able to choose 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
An empty doll. That's what the real "Gold 
City" actually was.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And now, I don't even have the energy left 
to fight back against it...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, it makes total sense that I 
wouldn't be able to answer if someone 
asked me 'Why do you run?'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ――What are you running for anyway?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...So in the end, there's no meaning in 
running anymore."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's all gone. I have nothing left now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—The "real me" never existed to begin 
with.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Desperately chasing after it. What I 
caught, reveled in, and crammed away has 
no weight to it at all, just like cotton.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And yet, thinking I can "prove the real 
me"... that's hilarious.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So lame, seriously. Way too lame...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list:
Even if you don't run, your future is 
still wide open.

Even if you don't run, your future is 
still wide open.

text_block_list.text:
Those first three years are certainly very 
important. However, whenever you feel like 
running again, you can run anytime, 
anywhere.
Except for the turf—at this very moment.
choice_data_list: Stopping isn't the same as running away.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If it's Mane-G, I know she'll give me the 
highest honor as a model.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You too... Well, I guess so. Even if 
you're training other girls, you wouldn't 
turn me away when I drop by to hang out, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even if I quit running, my fans will be 
waiting for me down another path...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Still. Even so, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I just can't say it. I can't bring myself 
to say... 'I'm done running.'

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I have to go.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even if I quit, I'm sure a great future 
awaits. And I think life would be way 
easier for me than it is now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Things didn't go the way I wanted, and I 
suffered so much. All I can remember is 
the painful stuff. But why—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Why can't I just... bring myself to say 'I 
quit'...?
choice_data_list: We'll definitely understand once we run!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

Pulling along a bewildered Gold City, I 
brought her to the track. She looked 
somewhat anxious—
choice_data_list: Try running with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even if you tell me to give it 
everything...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A-All right, I get it! Just keep your 
voice down...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haa, what was I even thinking...

And so, Gold City began to run. At first, 
she was just moving her legs, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—*pant*... *gasp*... Hey, how much longer 
are you gonna make me run...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So annoying...! Are you even watching? I'm 
running here, damn it...!

"'As an Umamusume model who's "too 
gorgeous"' 'The way she ran was just so 
beautiful!'"

“She's empty.” “She's amazing even though 
she's a model!” “So pretty.” “Pretty.” 
“Pretty.” ...—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Shut up, enough already! I don't need any 
of this...! If nobody is going to look at 
*me*...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't need any of it anymore...! Just 
stay out of my way when I'm running... 
dammit!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm sooooo damn tired...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Pushing an Umamusume this hard right 
before a race...!
choice_data_list: Have you had your fill of running now?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No way, that can't be...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I can't. I can't... let it end like this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's so agonizing, so frustrating, so 
painful...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, I don't want to quit. I... I want 
to run...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I want to run, Trainer...!

"I want to run"—that is, beyond a shadow 
of a doubt, the reason "Gold City" runs.

"Rebellion or whatever else, if she still 
chooses this knowing full well what it 
means... then that is her own will!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Running for a childish reason like this... 
...Won't people say that isn't beautiful 
again?
choice_data_list: You look absolutely beautiful right now.
You look so beautiful right now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list:
No one who saw that run would want her to 
quit.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Jeez. I told you to stop calling me 
pretty!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hearing it from you... isn't so bad.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Thanks...――

Her shy smile seemed to shine all the 
brighter in the sunset glow...
